question.text: Under Section 15EA of the SEBI Act read with SEBI (AIF) Regulations 2012, what is the penalty regime for a fund or its manager failing to comply with SEBI (AIF) Regulations?

answer.text: Fixed penalty of INR 10 lakh, one-time
Minimum penalty of INR 1 lakh; up to INR 1 lakh per day of non-compliance; subject to a maximum of INR 1 crore OR three times the gains from non-compliance, whichever is higher
Minimum penalty of INR 25 lakh; cap of INR 5 crore
Only cancellation of registration; no monetary penalty

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 15EA, the penalty is MIN INR 1 lakh; may extend up to INR 1 lakh PER DAY of non-compliance; subject to MAX INR 1 crore OR three times the amount of gains from non-compliance, whichever is HIGHER. The 'whichever higher' clause can escalate penalty rapidly for profitable non-compliance. The Trap: Option A flat-lines the penalty. Option C inflates the minimum. Option D understates SEBI's toolkit. Cross-Exam Context: III-A, III-C test SEBI penalty provisions. XIX-E caps it with the Cat III fund-level perspective. Manager's Pro-Tip: For prolonged breaches (leverage, concentration), daily tick-up can exceed INR 1 cr fast. Compliance trumps profit — the 'three-times gains' clause reverses any economic benefit.
